user.title: Set up Blue Iris
user.description: Set up your BlueIris Server details (to control profiles, fill in valid username and password)

features.title: Blue Iris features
features.description: Pick the features to set up. Cameras, sensors per camera and the rest are set in Configure afterwards.

server.name: Server
server.description: Blue Iris server status and controls on the server device. Controls need an admin user.

auto_reset.name: Auto reset defaults
auto_reset.description: Used by every camera that has not been changed on its own device page. Changing a camera's Auto Reset entities overrides these for that camera.

data.auto_reset_default_reboot: Reboot the camera after the last reset

data_description.auto_reset_default_reboot: Off by default. When the resets didn't help, reboot the camera itself once before giving up. Only works on cameras that support reboot through Blue Iris.

error.already_configured: BlueIris integration already configured with the name

blue_iris_additional_settings.title: Blue Iris options
blue_iris_additional_settings.description: Pick which components to create. **All** includes cameras added to Blue Iris later, **None** turns the section off, **Choose…** opens a checkbox list on the next page. Stream type, HA Streaming, Stream Method, Blue Iris log reporting and the auto reset defaults are on the server device (Configuration), and change at once.

data_description.allowed_problem_sensor: Cameras on battery or solar power, or that only stream when motion is detected, may need Problem Detection turned off: use the Problem Detection switch on that camera's device page (Configuration). It stops the Problem sensor and auto reset for that camera only, so this section can stay on All. Also turn off that camera's Watchdog in Blue Iris. You can also put #ha:no-detection in a camera's Notes (General tab in Blue Iris) to do the same from Blue Iris.

camera_controls.name: Camera controls
camera_controls.description: Admin user. Per camera, on its device page.

data_description.allowed_camera_snapshot: Saves a snapshot into Blue Iris' own clips database (timeline, UI3), not a file in Home Assistant.
data_description.allowed_camera_motion: Off by default. Turns motion detection on or off for the camera's active profile; read from Blue Iris every 5 minutes.
data_description.allowed_camera_reboot: Off by default. Reboots the camera itself; only works on cameras that support reboot through Blue Iris.

camera_sensors.name: Camera sensors
camera_sensors.description: Per camera, from Blue Iris' camera list on every poll.

data_description.allowed_camera_bitrate: kbit/s, with FPS and resolution as attributes. A sub-stream sensor is added for cameras that have one.
data_description.allowed_camera_recording: Off by default. From the 30 s poll, so short events can be missed; use the MQTT Motion sensors for motion.
data_description.allowed_camera_triggered: Off by default. From the 30 s poll; short triggers can be missed.
data_description.allowed_camera_alerting: Off by default. From the 30 s poll; short alerts can be missed.

mqtt_sensors.name: MQTT sensors
mqtt_sensors.description: Shown when the MQTT integration is set up.

server.name: Server
server.description: Blue Iris server status and controls on the server device. Controls need an admin user.

connection.name: Connection
connection.description: Server and login. A username and password with admin rights are needed for profiles, schedules and Reset Camera.

general.name: Logging

data_description.log_level: Applied every time Home Assistant starts or the integration reloads. Change it live, until the next restart, with the server's Log Level entity. Default keeps Home Assistant's own logging setup.

general.description: Stream type, HA Streaming, Stream Method, Blue Iris log reporting and the auto reset defaults are on the server device (Configuration), and change at once.

select_items.title: Choose components
select_items.description: Tick the items to create in each section.

It stops the Problem sensor and auto reset for that camera only, so this section can stay on All. Also turn off that camera's Watchdog in Blue Iris.
